headline: Ecuador Awards $324.6 Million Power Transmission Line Project to India's Kalpataru
summary: Ecuador awarded a contract to Indian firm Kalpataru to build a 500 kV electrical interconnexion line with Peru, requiring an investment of $324.6 million.
why: Cross-border grid interconnections improve regional energy security and power-sharing capabilities between South American neighbors.

impacts.name: Ecuador
impacts.why: Infrastructure investments bolster domestic power transmission capacity and regional energy integration.
